neighbours.label: Alignment of teaching material to standards: 'to' after aligned/aligns/maps in curriculum and course descriptions (aligned to the Common Core, maps to domain 3), vs physical or everyday alignment
fire: Every unit in this science kit is aligned to the Next Generation Science Standards.
The reading program aligns to state benchmarks for kindergarten through grade 3.
Each module of the training maps to one objective of the security exam.
Our printable phonics cards are aligned to the national curriculum for Year 1.
Teachers can check how each activity aligns to the grade 5 math standards.
The online course maps to the four domains of the project management exam.
These history lessons are fully aligned to the state social studies framework.
The quiz bank is aligned to the AP Biology learning objectives.
quiet: Every unit in this science kit is packed in a sturdy plastic box.
The reading program runs for kindergarten through grade 3 at our school.
Each module of the training takes about an hour to finish.
Our printable phonics cards are laminated so they last for years.
Teachers can check whether the shelves are aligned with the classroom wall.
The online course was recorded in a small studio last spring.
The planets aligned in a rare pattern visible just after sunset.
The mechanic aligned the front wheels of the truck before the trip.

predictions: ' to' after 'aligned'/'aligns'/'maps' in a curriculum, course or exam description reaches 0.6-0.9; physical alignment (wheels, stars, shelves) and the same materials without alignment stay under 0.1.
notes: Card: peaks on ' to' x4 (aligned to 3rd Grade SOLs, aligned to the common core), 's' (aligns to standards), ' aligned' (find aligned curricula), '-aligned' (Common Core-aligned), ' maps' (maps to domain 3). Probe: worksheets aligned to the Common Core 0.753, course aligns to state standards 0.857, lesson plan maps to domain 2 0.754, standards-aligned test 0.330; wheels aligned 0.013, stars aligned 0.009, recycled paper 0.013.
